metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: An epic adventure about friendship between a boy and a dragon that matches the excitement of Kung Fu Panda.

metas.name: Big Hero 6
metas.description: A heartwarming superhero story with a lovable robot that fans of Spider-Verse and Sonic will enjoy.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A hilariously chaotic family road trip movie with a unique visual style similar to Spider-Verse.

metas.name: Leo
metas.description: A funny and sweet musical about a class lizard that shares the humor and heart of films like Sing.

metas.name: Frozen
metas.description: Since they enjoyed Frozen II, they will love seeing how Anna and Elsa's journey originally began.

metas.name: The Incredibles
metas.description: A high-energy superhero family film that fits perfectly with their interest in animated action-comedies.

metas.name: Monsters, Inc.
metas.description: A creative and funny Pixar classic about monsters who are more scared of kids than kids are of them.

metas.name: Luca
metas.description: A beautiful story about friendship and sea monsters that has the whimsical feel of Studio Ghibli films.

metas.name: Elemental
metas.description: A visually stunning world-building story that explores emotions and identity much like Inside Out 2.

metas.name: Soul
metas.description: A musically driven, thoughtful adventure that appeals to fans of emotional Pixar films and Sing.

metas.name: Wish
metas.description: A magical musical about a girl making a wish on a star, continuing the tradition of Moana and Encanto.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: A fun adventure set inside video games that will appeal to fans of The Super Mario Bros. Movie and Sonic.

metas.name: Megamind
metas.description: A hilarious subversion of superhero tropes that matches the 'villain-turned-hero' fun of Despicable Me.

metas.name: Abominable
metas.description: A magical journey across China to return a Yeti home, similar in tone to Raya and the Last Dragon.

metas.name: Smallfoot
metas.description: A silly, musical take on the Bigfoot legend that focuses on friendship and questioning the unknown.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania
metas.description: A monster-themed comedy that focuses on family and humor rather than scares, perfect for kids.

metas.name: The Secret Life of Pets
metas.description: A fast-paced comedy about what animals do when humans aren't home, from the makers of Despicable Me.

metas.name: Trolls
metas.description: A high-energy, colorful musical filled with pop songs that fans of Sing and Moana will enjoy.

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
metas.description: An imaginative and very funny slapstick comedy about a machine that turns water into food.

metas.name: Paddington
metas.description: A charming and polite bear finds a family in London in this heartwarming live-action/CGI hybrid.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: An even more delightful sequel that emphasizes kindness and community, highly recommended for families.

metas.name: Minions
metas.description: Focuses entirely on the slapstick humor of the yellow henchmen they enjoyed in Despicable Me.

metas.name: The LEGO Movie
metas.description: A fast-paced, creative adventure that captures the fun of building and playing with toys.

metas.name: The Secret World of Arrietty
metas.description: A Studio Ghibli take on 'The Borrowers' that matches their interest in both Ghibli and that specific story.

metas.name: Mary and the Witch's Flower
metas.description: A magical fantasy film in the style of Studio Ghibli that fans of Kiki's Delivery Service will love.

metas.name: Wolfwalkers
metas.description: A stunningly animated adventure about a girl who can transform into a wolf, similar to Ghibli's fantasy works.

metas.name: The Iron Giant
metas.description: A classic, touching story about a young boy who befriends a giant robot from outer space.

metas.name: Lilo & Stitch
metas.description: A heartfelt story about a girl and her 'dog' that explores the meaning of 'Ohana' (family).

metas.name: Up
metas.description: An emotional and exciting adventure featuring a house flown by balloons and a talking dog.

metas.name: Cars
metas.description: A fun racing story about sportsmanship and small-town friendship that kids find very engaging.

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
metas.description: Since they've seen the first two, they'll want to see Po reunite with his father and master Chi.

metas.name: Shrek the Third
metas.description: Continuing the fairy tale comedy series they've already started with the first two Shrek movies.

metas.name: Bolt
metas.description: An action-packed adventure about a TV-star dog who thinks he actually has superpowers.

metas.name: Orion and the Dark
metas.description: A whimsical look at overcoming childhood fears that has the same imaginative feel as Inside Out.

metas.name: Ruby Gillman, Teenage Kraken
metas.description: A coming-of-age fantasy adventure about a shy girl who discovers she is royalty from a sea-dwelling race.

metas.name: Over the Moon
metas.description: A visually spectacular musical based on Chinese mythology that fans of Moana and Coco will love.

metas.name: Nimona
metas.description: An energetic fantasy adventure featuring a shapeshifter that matches the tone of The Bad Guys.

metas.name: Vivo
metas.description: A music-filled journey featuring songs by Lin-Manuel Miranda, perfect for fans of Moana and Encanto.

metas.name: The Book of Life
metas.description: A visually unique and vibrant celebration of culture and family that is a great companion to Coco.
